A road passing at 3550 m from base; car drives back/forth along road. Constant dist ~3550 suggests road roughly perpendicular... whatever. Loitering/repeated passes with stops — suspicious. The image shows D4 as white van/pickup but labeled truck. D1 and D4 overlap in frame (D1 box overlapping D4). D1 car and D4 truck at 13.7 m. D4 close-up: white pickup truck with cargo bed containing something (white material covered with tarp? there's something in the bed). It's a pickup, not a big truck. Bed appears loaded with something light-colored. Two people visible? Front seat shows occupants. D1 black car next to it.

T0223 close-up: shows vehicles on the road at top of frame — appears to be several cars, hard to see. It's the top edge region.

D8 close-up: just a white spot at the very edge — looks like a small white object, low conf 0.06, tiny. Likely false alarm or edge artifact; it's at right edge of frame on the service road. There was a white-ish blur. I'd call it unverified/possible false alarm, İZLE/NORMAL.

Also R017 claims 5 trucks stopped near 39.9283N 32.8120E at 11:05 — detections show 5 vehicles there (D2,D3,D5,D6,D7) but classes are cars/van, not trucks. Also they're not "stopped" — actually at 11:05-11:10 they're moving east toward base. Hmm, dist series shows jumps; the match is at capture time. Their motion: T0112 etc all heading east, heading_vs_base 0, approaching base at closing rates ~1.3-2.4 m/s, ETA 24-47 min. R017 partially consistent: 5 vehicles at that location, but class wrong (cars/van not trucks) and "durdugu" (stopped) — they are moving now. Say "kısmen uyumlu".

R032: "bir kamyon uzun suredir hareketsiz duruyor" at 39.92850,32.81195 — matches T0223 which has been stationary 120 min. T0223 has no detection; view shows some vehicles at top edge. Assessment: kısmen uyumlu — stationary vehicle confirmed (T0223, 2h), but class "kamyon" unverified (no detection). Could be tespitle uyumlu? There's no detection to compare; the track exists. I'd say "kısmen uyumlu": hareketsizlik doğrulanıyor (T0223 120 dk hareketsiz), sınıf kamyon görüntüde teyit edilemiyor (tespit yok).
